Michael Moxon | He was born on 23 January 1942 and educated at Merchant Taylors, Durham University and Heythrop College, London.  Ordained in 1971 he was a curate at Lowestoft then Sacrist of St Paul's Cathedral, Vicar of Tewkesbury and Canon of Windsor 1996 - 1998 before his move to Truro.
Edward White Benson | Edward White Benson (14 July 1829 – 11 October 1896) was the Archbishop of Canterbury from 1883 until his death.  He was the first Bishop of Truro, serving from 1877 to 1883, and began construction of Truro Cathedral.
